title: CODEA+ 2022 — Corpus de documentos españoles anteriores a 1900
institution: GITHE (Textos para la Historia del Español), Universidad de Alcalá; coordinator Pedro Sánchez-Prieto Borja
region: Spain (Iberian Peninsula), with some documents from Italy, Greece, Austria and elsewhere
notes: Archival documents from the origins of Spanish to 1899 (Archivo Histórico Nacional, Simancas, Indias, Corona de Aragón and many local archives), each with facsimile, paleographic and critical transcription; lemmatised and POS-tagged (>90% of the lexicon). Texts are read and searched in the web interface only; no bulk download found (the corpus conditions of use forbid derivative corpora). The DOI 10.37536/CODEA.2015 is the one given in the project's citation instructions. CODEA+ 2015 remains available separately. The documents themselves were not downloaded because the licence (CC BY-NC-ND) does not allow reuse of the documents in a corpus.
license_note: The site's 'Condiciones de uso' state: free consultation and use for teaching and research with citation; no commercial use; no derivative corpora; materials may be cited but not reused (Creative Commons by-nc-nd).
